meta.name: Le Notti Porno Nel Mondo, Emmanualle Sinnlickeit 1977
meta.description:
Clip show hosted by Laura Gemser, sort of a Mondo film. 
Clips include strip clubs, magic shows, naked girls, etc.
This one has so many different names and releases that it is difficult to keep them straight. This version is 1:30:13 with a German sound track and English subtitles.
